title: Room and connection contracts
description: The room (place) definition kind and its exits (21 §5 Place/Room, Connection; 05 §17; 00 §4.1, §4.10; 00a §2, §12), owned by movement (capability_registry.json). R5 slice 1: what look and move need. Details, tags, contents, description variants and barriers join with their capabilities as optional fields.

Connection.description: One directed exit to another room of the same cartridge (21 §5 Connection; 05 §17). Its identity is its room and direction, so a later optional barrier field (a DefinitionRef to one shared Barrier state, 21 §5 Barrier; 05 §25 coherent connections) adds state without changing what an exit without one means. A reciprocal exit is authored in the destination room (00a §2).

RoomDefinition.description: A navigable place (21 §5 Place/Room): its key, its title and description text keys (05 §18; resolved in the cartridge text catalog), and its exits by compass direction, the six-way compass of 00 §4.10 (a direction without an exit is absent). Custom named connections (05 §17) join later as a separate optional field.
